body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Madrid, Spain. The listing gives its length as 3 hours, over a route of about 2 km. It starts at Reina Sofía Museum, Calle de Santa Isabel, 52. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to the Reina Sofia Museum. There is no live guide: the tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone. WeGoTrip names Alexandra as the tour's author.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Discover the history of Spain in the 20th century through the groundbreaking art in the collection of the Museo Reina Sofia guided by this compelling in-app audio tour. Immerse yourself in the mesmerizing works of modern and contemporary masters, all while strolling through the halls of this renowned cultural gem.
>
> Bring the museum to life! The audio tour will help you to get a profound understanding of the artistic movements that shaped the 20th century. Explore Picasso’s iconic masterpiece, “Guernica” as well as surreal visions by Salvador Dali. Delve into the vibrant world of Spanish artists such as Joan Miró and Angeles Santos. Feel the emotional impact of art as you learn about the political and social context that inspired these visionary artists.
>
> The in-app audio tour offers flexibility and convenience, allowing you to explore at your own pace. Take breaks whenever you desire, revisit your favorite pieces, or pause to capture that perfect Instagram-worthy shot.
>
> Note! This tour is not affiliated with the Museo Reina Sofia but is provided by an independent creator. The ticket is included for the customer's convenience at no charge.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €16.79. It was rated 4.3 out of 5 from 212 ratings and 75 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from
